coverageExceptions.note: Mongolia is landlocked. Coal leaves via road and rail border crossings including Gashuunsukhait, Shivehuren and Khangi.

sourceOverrides.note: EIA Figure 8 estimates Iran supplied 11% of Chinese crude oil and condensate in 2024. EIA identifies Iranian crude relabeling as a material source of China’s declared Malaysia imports. Use that rounded share against the screened HS 2709 China total, subtract already-declared Iran tonnes, then cap at the screened Malaysia flow. This allocates routing only; it preserves the declared supplier, original BACI quantity and model import denominators. No attribution is made outside this product, trade pair and year. The available Malaysia bucket may be smaller than the EIA-implied misattribution, and the source provides no parcel-level match.

landTransfers.note: Argus reports 40 Mt via Transneft to China in 2024, separately from Kozmino loadings. EIA identifies the Skovorodino–Mohe branch of ESPO as a land pipeline. Assign observed tonnes to land, capped by screened bilateral tonnes. Apply the draft national seaborne port split to the remainder.

coverage.rankingMethod: Total screened 2024 BACI HS22 tonnes across HS 2709, HS 2710, HS 2701 and HS 271111. Pipeline gas is a separate land category. Country totals include re-exports and may differ from published national energy balances.
coverage.limit: At least one sourced energy route per ranked direction. Many country/product pairs and terminal throughput distributions are still unavailable and use approximate network ports. This table does not assign unsupported split percentages.
